summary: Iteration 6 testing (alerts, checkout theme_color, chain refresh/sync) — all backend and frontend acceptance criteria pass. 13/13 pytest tests pass, UI alert bell + popover + settings and brand/theme tab work correctly, /pay/{no} root carries --accent CSS var, chain refresh/sync return 200 with 0 errors in <30s.

detailed_results.alerts_api: GET /api/alerts admin -> 200, unread>=1, includes balance_change seed. Merchant/agent -> 403. POST /api/alerts/{id}/read -> 200. POST /api/alerts/read-all -> unread=0.
detailed_results.alerts_settings: GET returns {pct,min_abs,sync_minutes}. PUT {15,200,5} -> 200 (reflected). PUT pct=0 -> 400, min_abs=-1 -> 400, sync_minutes=0 -> 400. Restored to {10,100,10}.
detailed_results.checkout_theme: PUT theme_color #FF0000 -> 200 (reflected); PUT 'red' -> 400; /pay/SF2026101011193875904 root [data-testid=checkout-page] inline style contains '--accent: #FF0000', computed getPropertyValue('--accent') == '#FF0000'. Restored #2563EB.
detailed_results.chain: POST /api/chain/addresses/refresh -> {ok:3, errors:[]}. POST /api/chain/sync -> 200 in ~1-2s, errors=[]. GET /api/chain/addresses -> 3 items, all status=ok, numeric balances.
detailed_results.frontend_admin_alerts: Header shows alert-bell-btn. Clicking opens alert-popover with alert-item-{id}. alert-settings-btn opens form with alert-pct-input / alert-minabs-input / alert-sync-input / alert-settings-save-btn. Changed pct to 12, saved, API reflected 12, restored to 10. alert-read-all-btn is conditionally rendered only when unread>0 (per AlertBell.jsx line 81); after read-all was executed earlier it correctly hid and badge count=0.
detailed_results.frontend_non_admin: Merchant login -> header has NO alert-bell-btn (count=0). Correct.
detailed_results.frontend_brand_tab: Channels page -> checkout-settings-btn -> tab-brand shows theme-color-picker + theme-color-input with current value #2563EB. Typed #7C3AED, saved via checkout-settings-save-btn; GET /api/checkout/settings returned theme_color #7C3AED. Restored to #2563EB.
detailed_results.regression: Checkout page renders with brand header, QR, energy section (collapsed), '正在监听链上到账' indicator. Admin dashboard loads cleanly.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1773 lines — consider splitting into routers (alerts, chain, checkout, auth) for maintainability.
AlertBell.jsx hides alert-read-all-btn when unread==0 — expected and reasonable but worth documenting since task description refers to the testid unconditionally.
DialogContent missing aria-describedby — minor a11y warning in console.
seed_data_creation: None. Did not modify channels or addresses. Alert settings restored to {10,100,10}. theme_color restored to #2563EB. Alerts were marked read during testing (allowed per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration6.py is a self-contained regression suite. Note: tests mark all alerts read via POST /api/alerts/read-all; re-running will not re-create the seed balance_change alert, so TestAlerts.test_admin_list_alerts expectation of unread>=1 would fail on 2nd run unless a new alert is raised. If needed, trigger balance_change by changing a channel address balance threshold between syncs.
